adjustment.analysis: The baseline median is 95.5. A 20% off promotion with a price drop to $4.94 (19.9% below regular) is expected to drive lift. Past promotions show a noise-adjusted median lift of x1.58, but the recent 25% off in 2026-07-20 gave x1.55, suggesting diminishing returns. The product is trending on TikTok, adding uncertainty. However, the classical uplift model (x1.07) underweights the event. Adjusting for promotion lift (x1.58) and TikTok trend (moderate, not quantified), but shrinking toward 1.0 due to limited evidence and recent spike. No holiday overlap. No post-promo dip expected. Confidence is medium due to one-off trend.
